## 🇩🇪 German — Daily Phrases (3)
1. **Ich bin in meinem Element** — [ish bin in MY-nem eh-leh-MENT] — *I'm in my element*
2. **Das lässt mich nicht los** — [dahs lesst mish nisht lohs] — *That won't let go of me / It keeps occupying my mind*
3. **Mir fällt ein Stein vom Herzen** — [meer felt ine shtine fom HAIR-tsen] — *A weight has been lifted off my chest*
